name: Newegg marketplace (seller C.N.E Technology) price page for intel-arc-a770
notes: Refurbished Intel Arc A770 Limited Edition 16GB (21P01J00BA), 256-bit GDDR6, PCIe 4.0 x16. $409.00 asking price, free shipping, free 30-day returns, ships in ~4 business days from Hong Kong. Condition per listing = refurbished (tested/repaired, refurbisher warranty terms not published in the page). Same search showed a Sparkle A770 16GB refurb at $199.99 but that listing is OUT OF STOCK, so $409 is the buyable 16GB number. Note the 8GB A770 variants (GUNNIR) sell new at $349.00-$462.00 - do not confuse 8GB pricing with the 16GB card.
